name: zvideo_dd_prepare_window_for_mode
description: zVideo_dd::PrepareWindowForMode switches the main window to fullscreen popup/app-window style and snapshots the system palette on palettized desktops.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this Win32/GDI provider wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw window/mode-management pass.
The palette snapshot branch is host-environment dependent. The smoke verifies the saved palette buffer when RC_PALETTE is reported and verifies the non-palettized skip path on modern desktops.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a6930 validates SetMenu(g_zVideo_hWnd, 0), SetWindowLongA(GWL_EXSTYLE, WS_EX_APPWINDOW), SetWindowLongA(GWL_STYLE, WS_POPUP | WS_CLIPCHILDREN), UpdateWindow, SetFocus, the post-focus g_zVideo_hWnd guard, GetDC(0), GetDeviceCaps(RASTERCAPS) & RC_PALETTE, optional GetSystemPaletteEntries(0, 256, g_zVideo_SystemPaletteEntries), ReleaseDC(0, hdc), and return zero.

The native smoke creates a temporary Win32 window, verifies menu removal, verifies the fullscreen-popup/app-window style effects while allowing Win32 to preserve class-specific style bits such as WS_CLIPSIBLINGS, and verifies the system-palette buffer behavior for the host desktop palette capability.
